title: Slovakian Pork Casserole with Thai Twist
description: A hearty, dense casserole with the flavors of Thailand and traditional Slovakian ingredients. Perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: pork shoulder, diced
ingredients.notes: preferably with a layer of fat

instructions: In a large pan over medium-high heat, cook the diced onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the diced pork shoulder and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Stir in the coconut milk, fish sauce, and sugar. Bring to a simmer.
Add the cubed Slovakian rye bread and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and the bread is toasted.
Garnish with chopped Thai basil and serve hot.
